## Description
Summary of the changes made to prompts, templates, or documentation.

## Checklist
- [ ] Prompt preserves deep technical rigor and does not dilute instructions.
- [ ] Prompt follows the formatting standards in `AI_RULES.md`.
- [ ] Tested with at least one AI coding assistant (Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, Antigravity, etc.).
- [ ] Updated `prompts/README.md`, `README.md`, and `REPAIR_STATUS.md` if applicable.
